offering_description.value: Inspired Entertainment supplies gaming machines and software to gambling operators, lotteries, and leisure venues. It develops games and operating software, installs and manages machines at customer venues, and delivers virtual sports and online casino games through operator platforms.

primary_products.value: Gaming terminals; server-based gaming systems; virtual sports betting software; online casino games; amusement machines

primary_services.value: Managed gaming and amusement machine operations; field maintenance; game platform integration and hosting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Betting-shop operators, casinos, online sportsbooks and casinos, lottery operators, pubs, and leisure venues; B2G: Government lottery agencies that procure gaming systems or content

end_markets.value: Retail betting and gaming; sports betting; online casinos; lotteries; hospitality and leisure

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Shares of gaming proceeds from machines and digital games; product sales: Gaming terminals and related equipment; licensing or royalties: Access to gaming software, virtual sports, and casino game content; rental or leasing: Gaming and amusement machines placed at customer venues; service fees: Managed machine operations, platform services, and field maintenance
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; licensing or royalties; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Combines sourced hardware with in-house game software to supply terminals to gaming operators; software / platform: Develops games and integrates them with betting, casino, and lottery operators’ systems; service provider: Installs, monitors, and maintains equipment for gaming operators and venue owners; asset operator: Deploys and operates fleets of gaming and amusement machines at customer venues
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: United Kingdom, continental Europe, North America, and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Land-based gaming systems, virtual sports, online casino content, and leisure machines

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Equipment and content agreements with gambling operators, lotteries, and leisure venue groups; partners / resellers: Gaming platform providers and content aggregators that distribute games to operators

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Gaming supplier licensing and product certification by the UK Gambling Commission and other jurisdictional gaming regulators

notes: The current scope of its UK leisure-machine operations is uncertain.
